headline: Bear of the Day: Tractor Supply Company (TSCO)
summary: Rural retail powerhouse Tractor Supply Company's (TSCO) earnings outlook fell again after its Q2 earnings release on July 23, landing the stock a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).
